about: Stephen T. Dyer attended law school and graduated from The University of Texas School of Law in 1994. Stephen Dyer began practicing law in 1994.
Stephen Dyer is an attorney at Baker Botts L.L.P., helping people with Estate Planning & Probate issues. Baker Botts L.L.P. has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Stephen Dyer was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
